name: abstract-noise-waves
title: Abstract Noise Waves
description: Layered undulating sine wave ribbons flowing smoothly across an animated HTML5 canvas.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Organic
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Humanist
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Passive Canvas Waves: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
